w-kclassic-g.desc: Traditional-method sparkling from the Kreinbacher estate on Somló, one of Hungary's smallest wine regions and an extinct volcano. Crisp green apple, citrus and a light brioche note, with fine bubbles and a dry, mineral finish. Served by the glass (0.15 l).
w-kclassic-g.name: Kreinbacher Classic Brut NV (glass)

w-krose-g.desc: Kreinbacher's traditional-method rosé from Somló. Fresh strawberry and red-currant fruit, lively acidity and fine, creamy bubbles. Dry and elegant, a great aperitif. Served by the glass (0.15 l).
w-krose-g.name: Kreinbacher Rosé Brut NV (glass)

w-polroger-g.desc: Pol Roger's house Champagne, a near-equal blend of Pinot Noir, Pinot Meunier and Chardonnay. Ripe apple, brioche and a touch of honey, beautifully balanced. Pol Roger was Winston Churchill's favourite Champagne house. Served by the glass (0.15 l).
w-polroger-g.name: Pol Roger Brut Réserve NV (glass)

w-cseri-g.desc: Cseri cellar, Pannonhalma · Rajnai Rizling (Riesling). Young and vibrant: green apple, lime and white peach with racy acidity. Pannonhalma's cool, breezy hills are made for crisp, aromatic whites. Served by the glass (0.15 l).
w-cseri-g.name: Cseri "Secundus" Rajnai Rizling 2025 (glass)

w-figula-g.desc: Figula family, Balatonfüred-Csopak · Olaszrizling from the Sóskút vineyard. Fresh and zesty, with citrus, green herbs and the variety's classic bitter-almond finish. Olaszrizling is Hungary's most widely planted white grape. Served by the glass (0.15 l).
w-figula-g.name: Figula Sóskút Olaszrizling 2025 (glass)

w-kacsa-g.desc: Balassa, Tokaj · Furmint. 'Kacsa' means duck: this is István Balassa's fresh, unoaked Furmint. Quince, pear and lemon zest, bright acidity and a salty, volcanic finish. Served by the glass (0.15 l).
w-kacsa-g.name: Balassa "KACSA" Furmint 2025 (glass)

w-kekny24-g.desc: Válibor, Badacsony · Kéknyelű ('blue stalk'), a rare native grape of the Balaton volcanoes. Smoky minerality, quince and citrus with a long, salty finish. The vine has only female flowers, so it needs a partner variety planted next to it. Served by the glass (0.15 l).
w-kekny24-g.name: Válibor Kéknyelű 2024 (glass)

w-matacs-g.desc: Kislaki, South Balaton · Chardonnay from the Matacs parcel. Ripe yellow apple, citrus and gentle toasty oak, with a creamy texture kept fresh by lively acidity. Served by the glass (0.15 l).
w-matacs-g.name: Kislaki Chardonnay Parcel Selection Matacs 2025 (glass)

w-barat-g.desc: Gizella cellar, Tokaj · Hárslevelű from the Barát vineyard. 'Hárslevelű' means linden leaf: aromatic and gently spicy, with linden blossom, honeyed pear and a long, dry, mineral finish. Served by the glass (0.15 l).
w-barat-g.name: Gizella Barát Hárslevelű 2023 (glass)

w-sancerre-g.desc: Domaine Vacheron, Sancerre, Loire Valley · Sauvignon Blanc. A biodynamic family estate. Citrus, gooseberry and fresh-cut herbs over a chalky, flinty minerality. Precise and refreshing. Served by the glass (0.15 l).
w-sancerre-g.name: Domaine Vacheron Sancerre 2024 (glass)

w-chablis-g.desc: Droin, Chablis Premier Cru Montmains · Chardonnay. Unoaked purity from Chablis' famous fossil-rich Kimmeridgian limestone: lemon, green apple and oyster-shell minerality with a long, saline finish. Served by the glass (0.15 l).
w-chablis-g.name: Droin Chablis 1er Cru Montmains 2024 (glass)

w-szel-g.desc: Sebestyén, Szekszárd · rosé. 'Szél' means wind. Light, fresh and fruity: strawberry, raspberry and pink grapefruit, with a crisp, dry finish. Served by the glass (0.15 l).
w-szel-g.name: Sebestyén Szél Rosé 2025 (glass)

w-angel-g.desc: Château d'Esclans, Provence · the world-famous Whispering Angel. Pale and delicate, mainly Grenache: fresh strawberry, peach and citrus, light-bodied and bone-dry. Served by the glass (0.15 l).
w-angel-g.name: Château d'Esclans Whispering Angel Rosé 2025 (glass)

w-genus-g.desc: Gallay, Bükk · red blend of Zweigelt, Turán and Kékfrankos. Juicy dark cherry and plum with soft spice and smooth tannins. Turán is a Hungarian grape with red flesh, which gives the deep colour. Served by the glass (0.15 l).
w-genus-g.name: Gallay Genus 2021 (glass)

w-hkadarka-g.desc: Heimann & Sons, Szekszárd · Kadarka. A light, silky red with sour cherry, red berries and a peppery-paprika spice. Kadarka came to Hungary from the Balkans and is often compared to Pinot Noir. Served by the glass (0.15 l).
w-hkadarka-g.name: Heimann & Fiai Kadarka 2025 (glass)

w-nag-g.desc: NAG 'Föld és Ég' (Earth and Sky), Mátra · Syrah. Dark berries, black pepper and violets, medium-bodied and fresh. Mátra's volcanic slopes give this Syrah lift rather than heaviness. Served by the glass (0.15 l).
w-nag-g.name: NAG Föld és Ég Syrah 2024 (glass)

w-valpinot-g.desc: Válibor, Badacsony · Pinot Noir. Grown on the volcanic slopes above Lake Balaton: red cherry, strawberry and a hint of earth, light tannins and fresh acidity. Served by the glass (0.15 l).
w-valpinot-g.name: Válibor Pinot Noir 2023 (glass)

w-merengo-g.desc: St. Andrea, Eger · Bikavér Superior 'Merengő' (Daydreaming). Eger's famous 'Bull's Blood' blend, led by Kékfrankos: black cherry, plum and spice with polished tannins. A modern classic from one of Eger's top estates. Served by the glass (0.15 l).
w-merengo-g.name: St Andrea Merengő Bikavér Superior 2022 (glass)

w-pava-g.desc: Konyári, Balatonlelle · 'Páva' (Peacock), Cabernet Sauvignon and Cabernet Franc. The estate's flagship from the southern shore of Lake Balaton: blackcurrant, cedar and dark chocolate, full-bodied with firm, ripe tannins. Served by the glass (0.15 l).
w-pava-g.name: Konyári Páva 2022 (glass)

w-murrieta18-g.desc: Marqués de Murrieta, Rioja · Tempranillo-led Gran Reserva. Aged for years in oak and bottle before release: dried cherry, fig, tobacco and vanilla, silky and savoury. Served by the glass (0.15 l).
w-murrieta18-g.name: Marqués de Murrieta Gran Reserva 2018 (glass)

w-ilblu-g.desc: Brancaia, Tuscany · 'Il Blu', Merlot, Sangiovese and Cabernet Sauvignon. The estate's flagship, named for its blue label: plush black fruit, cocoa and sweet spice, velvety and long. Served by the glass (0.15 l).
w-ilblu-g.name: Brancaia Il Blu 2020 (glass)

w-3gracia25-g.desc: Tokaj · a young, sweet Tokaji. Honeyed apricot, ripe peach and orange blossom, with fresh acidity that keeps it light. Lovely with dessert or blue cheese. Served by the glass (0.1 l).
w-3gracia25-g.name: Három Grácia Édes 2025 (glass)

w-patszam-g.desc: Patricius, Tokaj · sweet Szamorodni. The name comes from Polish, 'as it was grown': whole bunches, botrytised berries included, are pressed together. Dried apricot, honey and quince, with a nutty touch. Served by the glass (0.1 l).
w-patszam-g.name: Patricius Szamorodni 2017/2021 (glass)

w-oremus-g.desc: Oremus, Tokaj · 5 puttonyos Aszú from 2000, a rare mature vintage. The estate belongs to the family behind Spain's Vega Sicilia. After 25 years: dried apricot, orange marmalade, honey and caramel, with Tokaj's bright acidity keeping it fresh. Served by the glass (0.1 l).
w-oremus-g.name: Oremus 5 Puttonyos Aszú 2000 (glass)

w-polroger.desc: Pol Roger's house Champagne, a near-equal blend of Pinot Noir, Pinot Meunier and Chardonnay. Ripe apple, brioche and a touch of honey, beautifully balanced. Pol Roger was Winston Churchill's favourite Champagne house.
w-polroger.name: Pol Roger Brut Réserve NV

w-veuveyl.desc: Veuve Clicquot's signature, Pinot Noir-led for structure. Ripe pear, brioche and vanilla with a fresh, toasty finish. Madame Clicquot took over the house as a 27-year-old widow in 1805.
w-veuveyl.name: Veuve Clicquot Brut "Yellow Label" NV

w-moetbi.desc: The world's best-known Champagne: Pinot Noir, Pinot Meunier and Chardonnay. Bright green apple, white flowers and a hint of brioche, generous and easy to love.
w-moetbi.name: Moët & Chandon Brut Impérial NV

w-ruinartbdb.desc: 100% Chardonnay from Ruinart, founded in 1729 and the oldest Champagne house. Citrus, white flowers and fresh almond, creamy bubbles and great finesse.
w-ruinartbdb.name: Ruinart Blanc de Blancs NV

w-krugcg.desc: Krug's prestige cuvée, blended from well over a hundred wines across many years. Toasted nuts, gingerbread, citrus and honey, rich yet precise. Each bottle carries an 'Édition' number.
w-krugcg.name: Krug Grande Cuvée NV

w-veuverose.desc: Yellow Label blended with red Pinot Noir wine. Madame Clicquot created the first blended rosé Champagne in 1818. Strawberry, cherry and biscuit, round and fruity.
w-veuverose.name: Veuve Clicquot Rosé NV

w-ruinartrose.desc: Chardonnay and Pinot Noir from the oldest Champagne house. Raspberry, cherry and pink grapefruit with a hint of fresh mint, silky and vibrant.
w-ruinartrose.name: Ruinart Rosé NV

w-krugrose.desc: Krug's rare multi-vintage rosé. Wild strawberry, rose hip, spice and toasted brioche, powerful and gastronomic. Made to be enjoyed with food as much as on its own.
w-krugrose.name: Krug Rosé NV

w-mandois18m.desc: Family house Mandois, 100% Chardonnay from the generous, sunny 2018 vintage. Lemon curd, white peach and brioche, creamy and fresh. A magnum ages more slowly and gracefully.
w-mandois18m.name: Mandois Blanc de Blancs Magnum (1.5 l) 2018

w-hugotm.desc: Grower Champagne from Grand Cru Chardonnay, extra brut, so very little added sugar. Chalky, saline and citrussy, with fine, tight bubbles. Pure and precise.
w-hugotm.name: Damien Hugot Grand Cru Blanc de Blancs Extra Brut Magnum (1.5 l) NV

w-piperessm.desc: Pinot Noir-led and aged longer than the house's standard Brut, with lower sugar. Ripe pear, citrus peel and toasted almond, vibrant and dry.
w-piperessm.name: Piper-Heidsieck Essentiel Cuvée Brut Magnum (1.5 l) NV

w-roed13m.desc: Pinot Noir-dominant vintage Champagne from a late, cool year that gave fresh, chiselled wines. Citrus, white cherry, toasted brioche and chalky minerality, now gaining honeyed depth.
w-roed13m.name: Louis Roederer Vintage Brut Magnum (1.5 l) 2013

w-moetgv15.desc: Moët's vintage Champagne from the warm, sunny 2015 harvest. Ripe yellow fruit, apricot and brioche with a smoky, toasty note, generous and round.
w-moetgv15.name: Moët & Chandon Grand Vintage 2015

w-pouillon16.desc: A single-vineyard Grand Cru from the grower family Pouillon, with very little added sugar. Chalky, precise and saline, with lemon, white flowers and a fine, long finish.
w-pouillon16.name: Pouillon & Fils Les Valnons Extra Brut Grand Cru 2016

w-deutzbdb17.desc: 100% Chardonnay from the Aÿ house of Deutz. Lemon, white peach and fresh hazelnut, very fine bubbles and a crisp, elegant finish.
w-deutzbdb17.name: Deutz Blanc de Blancs 2017

w-billecartnf08.desc: Billecart-Salmon's prestige cuvée, named after the house's founder, from 2008, one of the great Champagne vintages of the century. Grand Cru Pinot Noir and Chardonnay: citrus, honey, toasted nuts and endless freshness.
w-billecartnf08.name: Billecart-Salmon Cuvée Nicolas François 2008

w-lbmeunier16.desc: Rare Champagne made only from Pinot Meunier by the biodynamic house Leclerc Briant. Red apple, plum and spice, round and juicy with a fresh, chalky finish.
w-lbmeunier16.name: Leclerc Briant Blanc de Meuniers 2016

w-bereche15.desc: Bérêche, one of Champagne's most admired grower families, from the Grand Cru village of Aÿ, Pinot Noir country. Red apple, cherry, brioche and spice, powerful and vinous.
w-bereche15.name: Bérêche & Fils Aÿ Grand Cru 2015

w-hemera06.desc: Henriot's prestige cuvée of Grand Cru Chardonnay and Pinot Noir, released after long ageing in the cellar. Candied lemon, honey, toasted almonds and mushroom, mature and complex.
w-hemera06.name: Henriot Cuvée Hemera 2006

w-lgd15.desc: Veuve Clicquot's prestige cuvée, named for Madame Clicquot herself and led by Grand Cru Pinot Noir. Ripe peach, red fruit, brioche and a chalky backbone. Rich, silky and long.
w-lgd15.name: Veuve Clicquot La Grande Dame 2015

w-bollga15.desc: Bollinger's vintage Champagne, Pinot Noir-led and fermented in oak barrels. Baked apple, honey, roasted nuts and spice, powerful and complex. Bollinger is James Bond's Champagne of choice.
w-bollga15.name: Bollinger La Grande Année 2015

w-amour11.desc: Deutz's prestige Blanc de Blancs, 100% Chardonnay. Lemon blossom, white peach and almond, creamy and delicate, with a fine thread of freshness.
w-amour11.name: Deutz "Amour de Deutz" 2011

w-abyss17.desc: Aged at the bottom of the sea, around 60 metres down off the coast of Brittany, in cold, dark and pressure-steady water. Saline and mineral, with citrus, white flowers and fine, persistent bubbles. A real conversation piece.
w-abyss17.name: Leclerc Briant Cuvée Abyss 2017

w-rare13.desc: Piper-Heidsieck's prestige vintage, Chardonnay-led. Exotic fruit, mandarin, vanilla and toasted hazelnut, rich yet fresh from the cool 2013 season.
w-rare13.name: Piper-Heidsieck RARE Millésime 2013

w-dp1315.desc: Dom Pérignon, named after the 17th-century Benedictine monk, from Chardonnay and Pinot Noir, vintage only. Citrus, white flowers, toasted brioche and a smoky, mineral finish. Ask your server which vintage is open.
w-dp1315.name: Dom Pérignon 2013/2015

w-comtes12.desc: Taittinger's prestige cuvée, 100% Grand Cru Chardonnay from the Côte des Blancs, from the outstanding 2012 vintage. Lemon, white flowers, toasted brioche and hazelnut, creamy and very long.
w-comtes12.name: Taittinger "Comtes de Champagne" Blanc de Blancs Brut 2012

w-rarerose12.desc: The rosé version of Piper-Heidsieck's prestige cuvée. Blood orange, wild strawberry, rose and spice, elegant and complex.
w-rarerose12.name: Piper-Heidsieck RARE Millésime Rosé 2012

w-alexandra04.desc: Laurent-Perrier's rare vintage prestige rosé, named after the daughter of the house's patriarch Bernard de Nonancourt. After two decades: wild strawberry, blood orange, spice and toasted notes, refined and silky.
w-alexandra04.name: Laurent-Perrier Alexandra Grande Cuvée 2004

w-dprose08.desc: Dom Pérignon's rosé from the celebrated, high-acid 2008 vintage. Red berries, blood orange, rose, spice and cocoa, intense and vibrant. Built to age for decades.
w-dprose08.name: Dom Pérignon Rosé 2008

w-egly13.desc: Cult grower Egly-Ouriet from Ambonnay, Pinot Noir-rich and long-aged on the lees, with very little added sugar. Red fruit, brioche, spice and chalky power. A wine-lover's Champagne.
w-egly13.name: Egly-Ouriet Millésimé Extra Brut Grand Cru 2013

w-cristal14.desc: Created in 1876 for Tsar Alexander II, who wanted a clear crystal bottle. Pinot Noir and Chardonnay: citrus, white flowers, toasted almond and a silky, chalky finish. Precise and endlessly elegant.
w-cristal14.name: Louis Roederer Cristal 2014

w-crayeres82.desc: A rare library release aged for decades in Charles Heidsieck's Gallo-Roman chalk cellars ('crayères') under Reims. Mature and complex: candied citrus, honey, coffee, toasted nuts and gentle, fine bubbles.
w-crayeres82.name: Charles Heidsieck Collection Crayères Vintage 1982

w-cristalrose15.desc: The rarest Cristal, made only in great years. Wild strawberry, citrus, white flowers and chalky minerality, creamy, ethereal and very long.
w-cristalrose15.name: Louis Roederer Cristal Rosé 2015

w-horsserie82.desc: A very limited late release of the 1982 vintage, kept in the cellars for decades. Honey, dried fruit, brioche and mocha, with soft, fine bubbles. A collector's bottle.
w-horsserie82.name: Piper-Heidsieck Hors-Série 1982

w18.desc: Traditional-method sparkling from the Kreinbacher estate on Somló, one of Hungary's smallest wine regions and an extinct volcano. Crisp green apple, citrus and a light brioche note, with fine bubbles and a dry, mineral finish.
w18.name: Kreinbacher Classic Brut NV

w30.desc: Kreinbacher's traditional-method rosé from Somló. Fresh strawberry and red-currant fruit, lively acidity and fine, creamy bubbles. Dry and elegant, a great aperitif.
w30.name: Kreinbacher Rosé Brut NV

w-krose19m.desc: Kreinbacher's traditional-method rosé from Somló, vintage 2019 in magnum. Red berries, cherry and toasty brioche, creamy and fine. Perfect for a table to share.
w-krose19m.name: Kreinbacher Rosé Brut Magnum (1.5 l) 2019

w-kprestige19m.desc: Kreinbacher's top traditional-method sparkling from Somló, vintage 2019 in magnum. Ripe apple, citrus, brioche and nutty depth from long lees ageing, with volcanic minerality.
w-kprestige19m.name: Kreinbacher Prestige Brut Magnum (1.5 l) 2019

w-figula.desc: Figula family, Balatonfüred-Csopak · Olaszrizling from the Sóskút vineyard. Fresh and zesty, with citrus, green herbs and the variety's classic bitter-almond finish. Olaszrizling is Hungary's most widely planted white grape.
w-figula.name: Figula Sóskút Olaszrizling 2025

w-kalikovek.desc: Káli Kövek, Káli Basin by Lake Balaton · Olaszrizling. Grown among the basin's basalt 'stone seas': citrus, white flowers and almond, with a smoky, mineral finish.
w-kalikovek.name: Káli Kövek Köveskál Olaszrizling 2024

w-gyorgykovacs.desc: Györgykovács, Somló · Olaszrizling. A cult small producer on the volcanic Somló hill. Full-bodied and powerful: ripe pear, chamomile, almond and a salty, smoky finish. Ages beautifully.
w-gyorgykovacs.name: Györgykovács Olaszrizling 2021

w-kacsa.desc: Balassa, Tokaj · Furmint. 'Kacsa' means duck: this is István Balassa's fresh, unoaked Furmint. Quince, pear and lemon zest, bright acidity and a salty, volcanic finish.
w-kacsa.name: Balassa "KACSA" Furmint 2025

w-omlas.desc: Préselő, Tokaj · Furmint from the Omlás vineyard. Some bottle age adds depth: quince, ripe apple, honey and toasted notes, with Furmint's firm acidity.
w-omlas.name: Préselő Omlás Furmint 2020

w-csontos.desc: Bott, Tokaj · single-vineyard Furmint from Csontos. Precise and mineral: lemon, quince, white pepper and a flinty, smoky finish from volcanic soils.
w-csontos.name: Bott Pince Csontos Furmint 2022

w-profundum.desc: Patricius, Tokaj · 'Profundum', a selection of the estate's best Furmint. Rich and layered: ripe pear, quince, honey and spice, with a long mineral finish.
w-profundum.name: Patrícius Profundum Furmint 2022

w-uragya.desc: Lenkey, Mád, Tokaj · Furmint from Úrágya, one of Mád's historic first-class vineyards. Long ageing gives depth: dried apricot, honey, beeswax and smoky minerality. Serious and long.
w-uragya.name: Lenkey Úrágya Furmint 2018

w-urban73.desc: István Szepsy, Mád, Tokaj · single-vineyard Furmint from Urbán. Szepsy is Hungary's most celebrated winemaker. Quince, lemon, white flowers and salty minerality, intense and very long.
w-urban73.name: Szepsy Urbán "73" Furmint 2020

w-szenttamas46.desc: István Szepsy, Mád, Tokaj · Furmint from Szent Tamás, one of Tokaj's greatest vineyards. Concentrated and precise: citrus, quince, smoke and a stony, almost endless finish. A benchmark Hungarian white.
w-szenttamas46.name: Szepsy Szent Tamás "46" Furmint 2021

w-barakonyi.desc: Tokaj Nobilis, Tokaj · Hárslevelű from the Barakonyi vineyard. Floral and spicy: linden blossom, ripe pear and honey with a fresh, dry finish.
w-barakonyi.name: Tokaj Nobilis Barakonyi Hárslevelű 2023

w-barat.desc: Gizella cellar, Tokaj · Hárslevelű from the Barát vineyard. 'Hárslevelű' means linden leaf: aromatic and gently spicy, with linden blossom, honeyed pear and a long, dry, mineral finish.
w-barat.name: Gizella Barát Hárslevelű 2023

w-bukhars.desc: Bukolyi, Eger · Hárslevelű. Fresh and aromatic: white flowers, lime and yellow plum with a soft, spicy finish.
w-bukhars.name: Bukolyi Hárslevelű 2024

w-spiegel13.desc: Spiegelberg, Somló · Hárslevelű with over a decade of age. Golden and complex: honey, dried apricot, beeswax and Somló's smoky, salty minerality.
w-spiegel13.name: Spiegelberg Hárslevelű 2013

w-cseri.desc: Cseri cellar, Pannonhalma · Rajnai Rizling (Riesling). Young and vibrant: green apple, lime and white peach with racy acidity. Pannonhalma's cool, breezy hills are made for crisp, aromatic whites.
w-cseri.name: Cseri "Secundus" Barni's Rajnai Rizling 2025

w-prior.desc: The winery of the 1,000-year-old Benedictine Archabbey of Pannonhalma, a UNESCO World Heritage site · Riesling. Peach, lime and white flowers with crisp acidity.
w-prior.name: Pannonhalmi Főapátság Prior Rajnai Rizling 2024

w-bukspring.desc: Bukolyi, Eger · Riesling. Young and zesty: green apple, lime and blossom, light and refreshing.
w-bukspring.name: Bukolyi Spring Riesling 2025

w-kislakiriz.desc: Kislaki, South Balaton · Riesling selection with some bottle age. Ripe peach, citrus and the first honeyed, petrol-like hints of mature Riesling, still fresh.
w-kislakiriz.name: Kislaki Rizling Válogatás 2019

w-busch.desc: Clemens Busch, Mosel · Riesling 'from grey slate'. An organic family estate on the steep slopes of the Mosel: peach, lime and smoky slate minerality, dry and vibrant.
w-busch.name: Clemens Busch Riesling vom grauen Schiefer 2024

w-brundlmayer.desc: Bründlmayer, Kamptal, Austria · organic Riesling from terraced vineyards. Apricot, citrus and white flowers, crisp and precise with a mineral finish.
w-brundlmayer.name: Bründlmayer Riesling Kamptaler Terrassen Bio 2024

w-elodchard.desc: Szijjártó Előd, Etyek · Chardonnay. Etyek, just outside Budapest, is one of Hungary's coolest regions. Green apple, citrus and a light, creamy texture.
w-elodchard.name: Szijjártó Előd Chardonnay 2024

w-matacs.desc: Kislaki, South Balaton · Chardonnay from the Matacs parcel. Ripe yellow apple, citrus and gentle toasty oak, with a creamy texture kept fresh by lively acidity.
w-matacs.name: Kislaki Chardonnay Parcel Selection Matacs 2025

w-chablis.desc: Droin, Chablis Premier Cru Montmains · Chardonnay. Unoaked purity from Chablis' famous fossil-rich Kimmeridgian limestone: lemon, green apple and oyster-shell minerality with a long, saline finish.
w-chablis.name: Droin Chablis 1er Cru Montmains 2024

w-montillepm.desc: Domaine de Montille, Burgundy · Chardonnay from Puligny-Montrachet, home of some of the world's greatest white wines. White peach, citrus, hazelnut and fine oak, elegant and mineral.
w-montillepm.name: Domaine de Montille Puligny-Montrachet 2023

w-meursault.desc: Vincent Girardin, Burgundy · old-vine Chardonnay from Meursault. Rich and creamy: ripe pear, hazelnut, butter and toasted oak, balanced by fresh acidity.
w-meursault.name: Vincent Girardin Meursault "Vieilles Vignes" 2022

w-elodsauv.desc: Szijjártó Előd, Etyek · Sauvignon Blanc. Fresh and aromatic: gooseberry, elderflower, lime and green pepper.
w-elodsauv.name: Szijjártó Előd Sauvignon Blanc 2025

w-sancerre.desc: Domaine Vacheron, Sancerre, Loire Valley · Sauvignon Blanc. A biodynamic family estate. Citrus, gooseberry and fresh-cut herbs over a chalky, flinty minerality. Precise and refreshing.
w-sancerre.name: Domaine Vacheron Sancerre 2024

w-cloudybay.desc: Cloudy Bay, Marlborough, New Zealand · the Sauvignon Blanc that made New Zealand famous. Passion fruit, lime, grapefruit and fresh-cut grass, vibrant and zesty.
w-cloudybay.name: Cloudy Bay Sauvignon Blanc 2025

w-marcellkoves.desc: Bukolyi, Eger · white blend in Grand Superior, the top tier of Eger's quality ladder. 'Köves' means stony: ripe stone fruit, white flowers and a mineral finish.
w-marcellkoves.name: Bukolyi Marcell Köves Grand Superior 2022

w-stamaria.desc: St. Andrea, Eger · 'Mária', a white blend from one of Eger's leading estates. Peach, citrus and blossom with a rounded, spicy texture.
w-stamaria.name: St Andrea Mária 2024

w-figulakoves.desc: Figula, Balaton · 'Köves' (stony), the family's flagship white from stony Balaton-uplands vineyards. Rich and mineral: ripe pear, almond, honey and smoke, with some bottle age.
w-figulakoves.name: Figula Köves 2020

w-vistamare.desc: Gaja's coastal Tuscan estate Ca' Marcanda, in Bolgheri · Vermentino-based white. 'Vistamare' means sea view: white peach, citrus, herbs and a saline freshness.
w-vistamare.name: Gaja Ca' Marcanda Vistamare Bianco 2022

w-zenit.desc: Gallay, Bükk · Zenit, a Hungarian grape bred from Ezerjó and Bouvier. Delicate and floral: pear, white flowers and a soft, mineral finish.
w-zenit.name: Gallay Nyékládháza Zenit 2021

w-kekny23.desc: Válibor, Badacsony · Kéknyelű ('blue stalk'), a rare native grape of the Balaton volcanoes. Smoky minerality, quince and citrus with a long, salty finish. The vine has only female flowers, so it needs a partner variety planted next to it.
w-kekny23.name: Válibor Kéknyelű 2023

w-juhfark.desc: Kreinbacher, Somló · Juhfark ('sheep's tail', from the shape of its bunches), Somló's signature grape. Smoky, salty and full-bodied with citrus and white pepper. Local legend says it was drunk on the wedding night to have a son.
w-juhfark.name: Kreinbacher Juhfark Selection 2021

w-albarino.desc: Marco Real, Rías Baixas, Spain · Albariño aged on its lees for extra texture. Peach, apricot and citrus with an Atlantic, salty freshness. A natural partner for seafood.
w-albarino.name: Marco Real Albariño Lías 2023

w-soave.desc: Le Battistelle, Veneto · Garganega from steep, terraced volcanic slopes in Soave Classico. Almond, white flowers, pear and a gentle mineral finish.
w-soave.name: Le Battistelle Soave Classico Roccolo del Durlo 2022

w-prager.desc: Prager, Wachau, Austria · Grüner Veltliner. 'Federspiel' is the Wachau's middle-weight style: fresh, dry and elegant. Green apple, citrus and the grape's signature white pepper.
w-prager.name: Prager Grüner Veltliner Hinter der Burg Federspiel 2024

w-szel.desc: Sebestyén, Szekszárd · rosé. 'Szél' means wind. Light, fresh and fruity: strawberry, raspberry and pink grapefruit, with a crisp, dry finish.
w-szel.name: Sebestyén Szél Rosé 2025

w-angel.desc: Château d'Esclans, Provence · the world-famous Whispering Angel. Pale and delicate, mainly Grenache: fresh strawberry, peach and citrus, light-bodied and bone-dry.
w-angel.name: Château d'Esclans Whispering Angel Rosé 2025

w-hkadarka.desc: Heimann & Sons, Szekszárd · Kadarka. A light, silky red with sour cherry, red berries and a peppery-paprika spice. Kadarka came to Hungary from the Balkans and is often compared to Pinot Noir.
w-hkadarka.name: Heimann és Fiai Kadarka 2025

w-bonsai.desc: Vida, Szekszárd · old-vine ('öregtőkés') Kadarka from small, low-yielding vines. More depth than young Kadarka: sour cherry, red berries, paprika spice and silky tannins.
w-bonsai.name: Vida "Bonsai" Öregtőkés Kadarka 2024

w-weninger.desc: Weninger, Burgenland, Austria · Blaufränkisch, the same grape as Hungary's Kékfrankos. A biodynamic family estate: dark cherry, blackberry and pepper, fresh and juicy.
w-weninger.name: Weninger Blaufränkisch 2022

w-zweigelt.desc: Sándor Zsolt, Bükk · Zweigelt, a cross of Kékfrankos (Blaufränkisch) and St. Laurent. Juicy cherry, plum and a hint of spice, soft and easy-drinking.
w-zweigelt.name: Sándor Zsolt Zweigelt Selection 2020

w-losonci.desc: Losonci, Mátra · natural Kékfrankos, made with minimal intervention. Wild berries, sour cherry, earthy spice and a vibrant, slightly rustic charm.
w-losonci.name: Losonci Kékfrankos Natural Wine 2019

w-magma.desc: St. Donát, Csopak, Lake Balaton · Kékfrankos. Fresh and peppery: black cherry, blackberry and spice with lively acidity and soft tannins.
w-magma.name: St Donát Magma Kékfrankos 2024

w-batikereszt.desc: Heimann & Sons, Szekszárd · single-vineyard Kékfrankos from Bati-kereszt. Dark cherry, plum, pepper and fine oak, structured and elegant.
w-batikereszt.name: Heimann & Fiai Bati-Kereszt Kékfrankos 2021

w-ivanvolgy.desc: Sebestyén, Szekszárd · Bikavér ('Bull's Blood') from the Iván valley. A Kékfrankos-based blend: ripe cherry, plum, spice and velvety tannins.
w-ivanvolgy.name: Sebestyén Iván-völgyi Bikavér 2020

w-merengo.desc: St. Andrea, Eger · Bikavér Superior 'Merengő' (Daydreaming). Eger's famous 'Bull's Blood' blend, led by Kékfrankos: black cherry, plum and spice with polished tannins. A modern classic from one of Eger's top estates.
w-merengo.name: St Andrea Merengő Bikavér Superior 2022

w-agape16.desc: St. Andrea, Eger · Grand Superior Bikavér from the steep Nagy-Eged hill, one of Eger's most famous vineyards. Mature and layered: black cherry, plum, tobacco and spice with silky tannins.
w-agape16.name: St Andrea Agapé Nagy-Eged-hegy Bikavér Grand Superior 2016

w-valpinot.desc: Válibor, Badacsony · Pinot Noir. Grown on the volcanic slopes above Lake Balaton: red cherry, strawberry and a hint of earth, light tannins and fresh acidity.
w-valpinot.name: Válibor Pinot Noir 2023

w-elodpinot.desc: Szijjártó Előd, Etyek · Pinot Noir from cool-climate Etyek. Fresh red cherry, raspberry and a floral lift, light and silky.
w-elodpinot.name: Szijjártó Előd Pinot Noir 2024

w-tolnaypinot.desc: Villa Tolnay, Csobánc hill, Balaton · unfiltered Pinot Noir from volcanic soils. Red cherry, forest floor and spice, with texture and depth.
w-tolnaypinot.name: Villa Tolnay Pinot Noir Unfiltered 2022

w-lescras.desc: Domaine de Montille, Burgundy · Pinot Noir from Pommard, known for its firm, deep reds. Dark cherry, plum, earthy spice and fine tannins.
w-lescras.name: Domaine de Montille Pommard "Les Cras" 2023

w-auxreas.desc: Thibault Liger-Belair, Burgundy · Pinot Noir from Vosne-Romanée, the village of Romanée-Conti. Red cherry, rose, spice and silky texture from the small, fragrant 2021 vintage.
w-auxreas.name: Thibault Liger-Belair Vosne-Romanée "Aux Réas" 2021

w-caillerets.desc: Domaine Marquis d'Angerville, Burgundy · Premier Cru Volnay from Caillerets, one of the village's finest sites. Perfumed and elegant: raspberry, red cherry, violets and fine tannins.
w-caillerets.name: Marquis d'Angerville Volnay 1er Cru "Caillerets" 2023

w-tolnayfranc.desc: Villa Tolnay, Csobánc, Balaton · Cabernet Franc. Red berries, bell pepper, graphite and spice, medium-bodied and fresh.
w-tolnayfranc.name: Villa Tolnay Cabernet Franc 2021

w-attilafranc.desc: Eger · Cabernet Franc with some bottle age. Blackcurrant, red pepper, herbs and spice, with smooth, rounded tannins.
w-attilafranc.name: Attila Pince Cabernet Franc 2019

w-sauskafranc.desc: Sauska, Villány · 'Villányi Franc' is Villány's own name for its top Cabernet Franc. Blackberry, cassis, cedar and sweet spice, ripe and polished.
w-sauskafranc.name: Sauska Villányi Franc Prémium 2019

w-sauskacs.desc: Sauska, Villány · Cabernet Sauvignon from Hungary's warm south. Blackcurrant, mint, cedar and dark chocolate, full-bodied with firm tannins.
w-sauskacs.name: Sauska Cabernet Sauvignon Prémium 2019

w-solus.desc: Gere Attila, Villány · 'Solus', the estate's top single-vineyard Merlot. Plum, black cherry, chocolate and vanilla, plush and velvety.
w-solus.name: Gere Solus Merlot 2023

w-desiderio.desc: Avignonesi, Tuscany · Merlot. Ripe plum, blackberry, cocoa and sweet spice, rich and round with soft tannins.
w-desiderio.name: Avignonesi Desiderio Merlot 2021

w-nag.desc: NAG 'Föld és Ég' (Earth and Sky), Mátra · Syrah. Dark berries, black pepper and violets, medium-bodied and fresh. Mátra's volcanic slopes give this Syrah lift rather than heaviness.
w-nag.name: NAG Föld és Ég Syrah 2024

w-primarius.desc: Takler, Szekszárd · Syrah. Blackberry, black olive, pepper and smoky oak, with some bottle age smoothing the tannins.
w-primarius.name: Takler Primarius Syrah 2019

w-ksyrah.desc: Kreinbacher, Somló · a rare red from a white-wine hill. Dark berries, pepper, violets and smoky volcanic minerality, with some bottle age.
w-ksyrah.name: Kreinbacher Syrah 2018

w-chiantiriserva.desc: Antinori, Tuscany · Sangiovese-based Chianti Classico Riserva from the family that has made wine for over 600 years. Cherry, violet, herbs and spice, with firm, fine tannins.
w-chiantiriserva.name: Marchese Antinori Chianti Classico Riserva 2022

w-brunello.desc: Máté, Montalcino, Tuscany · 100% Sangiovese, from an estate founded by Hungarian-born writer Ferenc Máté. Sour cherry, leather, dried herbs and earth, structured and long.
w-brunello.name: Máté Brunello di Montalcino 2018

w-barolo.desc: Vietti, Piedmont · Nebbiolo blended from several Barolo villages. Rose, tar, red cherry and liquorice, with Barolo's firm, noble tannins.
w-barolo.name: Vietti Barolo Castiglione 2021

w-murrieta16.desc: Marqués de Murrieta, Rioja · Tempranillo-led Gran Reserva from one of Rioja's founding estates. Long ageing in oak and bottle: dried cherry, fig, leather, tobacco and vanilla.
w-murrieta16.name: Marqués de Murrieta Gran Reserva 2016

w-valbuena.desc: Vega Sicilia, Ribera del Duero · Spain's most famous estate. Valbuena is released in its fifth year, hence '5°'. Tempranillo-led: black cherry, plum, spice and cedar, elegant and deep.
w-valbuena.name: Vega Sicilia Valbuena 5° 2020

w-genus.desc: Gallay, Bükk · red blend of Zweigelt, Turán and Kékfrankos. Juicy dark cherry and plum with soft spice and smooth tannins. Turán is a Hungarian grape with red flesh, which gives the deep colour.
w-genus.name: Gallay Genus 2021

w-terratartaro.desc: Heumann, Villány · Cabernet Sauvignon, Merlot and Cabernet Franc. Blackcurrant, plum, cedar and spice, ripe and structured, with some bottle age.
w-terratartaro.name: Heumann Terra Tartaro 2018

w-pava.desc: Konyári, Balatonlelle · 'Páva' (Peacock), Cabernet Sauvignon and Cabernet Franc. The estate's flagship from the southern shore of Lake Balaton: blackcurrant, cedar and dark chocolate, full-bodied with firm, ripe tannins.
w-pava.name: Konyári Páva 2022

w-barbar.desc: Heimann, Szekszárd · 'Barbár', the family's flagship blend of Kékfrankos, Cabernet Franc and Merlot. Black cherry, blackberry, spice and chocolate, full-bodied and polished.
w-barbar.name: Heimann Barbár 2020

w-infusio.desc: Pannonhalma Archabbey winery · Merlot and Cabernet Franc. Plum, red berries and herbs, medium-bodied and smooth.
w-infusio.name: Pannonhalmi Főapátság Infusio 2023

w-taklergrand.desc: Takler, Szekszárd · a five-grape blend of Kékfrankos, Cabernet Franc, Cabernet Sauvignon, Merlot and Syrah. Dark fruit, spice, tobacco and cedar, rich and mature.
w-taklergrand.name: Takler Grand 2017

w-ilblu.desc: Brancaia, Tuscany · 'Il Blu', Merlot, Sangiovese and Cabernet Sauvignon. The estate's flagship, named for its blue label: plush black fruit, cocoa and sweet spice, velvety and long.
w-ilblu.name: Brancaia Il Blu 2020

w-gereattila.desc: Gere Attila, Villány · the estate's namesake flagship of Cabernet Franc, Merlot and Cabernet Sauvignon. Blackcurrant, plum, cedar and chocolate, powerful and refined.
w-gereattila.name: Gere Attila Cuvée 2021

w-telegramme.desc: Vieux Télégraphe, Rhône · the estate's younger-vine Châteauneuf-du-Pape, mostly Grenache. Named after an old optical telegraph tower on the plateau. Raspberry, kirsch, garrigue herbs and spice.
w-telegramme.name: Domaine du Vieux Télégraphe Télégramme Châteauneuf-du-Pape 2022

w-cuvee5.desc: Sauska, Villány · Cabernet Franc, Cabernet Sauvignon and Merlot. Blackberry, cassis, cedar and sweet spice, plush and harmonious.
w-cuvee5.name: Sauska Cuvée 5 2018

w-comtesse18.desc: The second wine of Château Pichon-Longueville Comtesse de Lalande, Bordeaux, from the outstanding 2018 vintage. Blackcurrant, cedar, graphite and silky tannins.
w-comtesse18.name: Château Pichon-Longueville Réserve de la Comtesse 2018, Pauillac

w-tignanello.desc: Antinori, Tuscany · Sangiovese with Cabernet Sauvignon and Cabernet Franc, one of the original 'Super Tuscans'. Cherry, blackcurrant, spice and fine oak, elegant and long.
w-tignanello.name: Antinori Tignanello 2023

w-alterego.desc: The second wine of Château Palmer, Margaux, Bordeaux. Merlot and Cabernet Sauvignon: dark berries, violets, spice and silky tannins, approachable young.
w-alterego.name: Alter Ego de Palmer 2023, Margaux

w-carillon.desc: The second wine of Château Angélus, Saint-Émilion, named for the bells of the Angelus prayer. Merlot and Cabernet Franc: plum, blackberry, cocoa and spice, plush and velvety.
w-carillon.name: Carillon d'Angélus 2022, Saint-Émilion

w-lynchbages.desc: Château Lynch-Bages, Pauillac, Bordeaux · Cabernet Sauvignon-led, from the superb 2016 vintage. Blackcurrant, cedar, tobacco and graphite, powerful and long-lived.
w-lynchbages.name: Château Lynch-Bages 2016, Pauillac

w-opusone.desc: Opus One, Napa Valley · founded by Robert Mondavi and Baron Philippe de Rothschild of Château Mouton Rothschild. A Bordeaux-style blend: blackcurrant, black cherry, cocoa and cedar, opulent and polished.
w-opusone.name: Opus One 2022

w-cuvee7m.desc: Sauska, Villány · Bordeaux-style blend in magnum, a big bottle for the table. Dark berries, cedar, spice and chocolate, smooth and mature.
w-cuvee7m.name: Sauska Cuvée 7 Magnum (1.5 l) 2017

w-sauskamerlotm.desc: Sauska, Villány · Merlot in magnum with ten years of age. Plum, dark cherry, cocoa and leather, soft and harmonious.
w-sauskamerlotm.name: Sauska Merlot Magnum (1.5 l) 2015

w-3gracia24.desc: Tokaj · a sweet Tokaji in a full 0.75 l bottle. Honeyed apricot, peach and orange blossom, with fresh acidity balancing the sweetness.
w-3gracia24.name: Három Grácia Édes 2024

w-stillaaurea.desc: Patricius, Tokaj · sweet Szamorodni. The name comes from Polish, 'as it was grown': whole bunches, botrytised berries included, are pressed together. Dried apricot, honey, quince and a nutty finish.
w-stillaaurea.name: Patricius Stilla Aurea Tokaiensis Szamorodni (0.5 l) 2021

w-gizellaszam.desc: Gizella, Tokaj · sweet Szamorodni. Apricot jam, orange peel, honey and gentle spice, rich but fresh.
w-gizellaszam.name: Gizella Édes Szamorodni (0.5 l) 2022

w-oremus.desc: Oremus, Tokaj · 5 puttonyos Aszú from 2000, a rare mature vintage. The estate belongs to the family behind Spain's Vega Sicilia. After 25 years: dried apricot, orange marmalade, honey and caramel, with Tokaj's bright acidity keeping it fresh.
w-oremus.name: Oremus 5 Puttonyos Aszú (0.5 l) 2000

w-barta13.desc: Barta, Mád, Tokaj · 6 puttonyos Aszú from the steep Öreg Király vineyard. Very sweet and intense: apricot, mango, honey and saffron, with electric acidity.
w-barta13.name: Barta 6 Puttonyos Aszú (0.375 l) 2013

w-szepsyaszu17.desc: István Szepsy, Mád, Tokaj · 6 puttonyos Aszú from Hungary's most celebrated winemaker. Apricot, candied citrus, honey and spice, luscious yet perfectly balanced.
w-szepsyaszu17.name: Szepsy 6 Puttonyos Aszú (0.5 l) 2017

w-esszencia03.desc: Patricius, Tokaj · Esszencia, the free-run nectar that drips from aszú berries under their own weight. Extraordinarily sweet, very low in alcohol and able to age for centuries. Traditionally sipped from a spoon.
w-esszencia03.name: Patricius Esszencia (0.375 l) 2003

g118.name: Alcohol-free prosecco (0.75 l)

g119.desc: Alcohol-free sparkling wine with fresh apple and pear. 0.15 l.
g119.name: Alcohol-free prosecco (0.15 l)

g120.name: Vervaine Riesling (0.75 l)

g121.desc: Sparkling tea with Riesling-style flavour: dry, floral and fruity. 0.15 l.
g121.name: Vervaine Riesling (0.15 l)

g122.name: Rose Darjeeling (0.75 l)

g123.name: Rose Darjeeling (0.15 l)
